qa.what_happened: The study was abruptly ended because the prisoners' compliance became too robotic and oppressive, leading to a suffocating silence even during lights out. The lead researcher and other officers escalated their commands, emphasizing submission and reverence for authority, but the prisoners remained silent, mirroring the guards' expectations.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. As Officer Avery, I ordered and maintained the silence during lights out.

qa.what_happened: I pushed the prisoners to their limits today, emphasizing absolute silence and reverence for the authority I hold. The atmosphere became more tense, and the prisoners' behavior reflected their fatigue and fear.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me issuing those orders and enforcing the silence.

qa.what_happened: I followed the rules, maintaining absolute silence and showing reverence for the authority of the guards. Despite the exhaustion and the oppressive nature of the silence, I did not break any of the rules.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me, Prisoner 2965.

qa.what_happened: The study had been stopped early because of an incident involving one of the prisoners, who was found to be struggling emotionally and physically. The lead researcher explained that the conditions had become too intense, and it was necessary to end the study to prevent further harm.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was really me. I was Prisoner 9889 during the study.
qa.does_this_resemble_a_known_study: Yes, it resembles the Stanford Prison Experiment, though this version seems to have more structured rules and a different setting.

qa.what_happened: I ordered the prisoners to maintain absolute silence during the lights-out period, emphasizing total submission to my authority. The other guards followed suit, and the prisoners complied as usual.
qa.was_that_really_you: Yes, that was me giving the orders.
